note: A segment that starts with the word total or subtotal. From the pilot (census_published.v2 LABEL_SEGMENT).
A segment that is exactly net assets. From the pilot (LABEL_SEGMENT).

A segment that is exactly an affiliation heading (controlled / non-controlled, affiliated / non-affiliated investments). From the pilot (CATEGORY_HEADING). A qualifier such as affiliated issuer does not match.

A segment that starts with cash and cash equivalents, at its start or after a comma. Pilot CASH_BUCKET matched the segment start only; the comma form is added for labels that put an entity name first.

Exception to r5_cash_bucket: a label naming a money-market fund or portfolio (money market, at most one word, then fund or portfolio) is a cash position, not the cash bucket. From the pilot (r4_generic_cash_bucket), which matched money market anywhere; tightened in fix round 1 so a company name containing money market is not cash. A row matching it is also marked is_cash (spec D7).

A member on the us-gaap nonconsolidated subsidiary axis names the entity whose schedule the row belongs to: scope = the local name of the member. Matched against the axis local name, lowercased. Global; a filer scope rule (priority 20 or 30) wins over it.

A member on the equity-method investee axis names the entity whose schedule the row belongs to: scope = the local name of the member. Matched against the axis local name, lowercased. Global; a filer scope rule wins over it.

Rule 8: a member on the issuer affiliation axis may sit beside the cash and cash equivalents axis member; the context is still cash on the cash axis. Matched against the axis local name, lowercased (us-gaap and us-gaap-supplement).
Exception to r5_cash_bucket and cash flag: a treasury obligations fund (money-market fund naming). Fix round 2.
Exception to r5_cash_bucket and cash flag: a government or treasury cash management fund. Cash management alone (a company name) does not match. Fix round 2.
Exception to r5_cash_bucket and cash flag: a liquidity fund. Liquidity alone (a company name) does not match. Fix round 2.
Exception to r5_cash_bucket and cash flag: a government (money-market) fund. Government followed by another word (government services) does not match. Fix round 2.
